[NLFC.5.1] Time-driven behaviour (TTL retraction, dwell, cooldown,
a single pattern's `within`, series windows) reads the engine's monotonic
clock, and `now()` its wall clock ([LTIM.2.8.1]). A `then … within` sequence
reads neither: it compares its facts' `ts` values ([LTIM.2.8.2]). Live tests are flaky; deterministic
tests use the mock clock, which drives both.
